shared_elements: shallow relief carving on coarse weathered stone
circular disc or concentric circle element
paired symmetrical curls flanking a centre
horizontal banded register near the lower edge
incised linear grooves forming a bar or strap
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, rounded-relief curvilinear ornament built from spirals/volutes flanking a central circular disc, with a banded horizontal register below, and both are executed in coarse, pitted, weathered stone with similar carving depth. The decisive difference is format and density: A is a flat, broken slab covered edge to edge with dense, diagonally organised interlocking scrollwork, whereas B is a fully three-dimensional standing figure with a head and torso whose sparse, symmetrical ornament is confined to the chest.
